body:
DELIVERED (real numeric E3 sweep of the row-204 transaction triad) + codex-driven; AC-TXN-5/5A numeric sweep split to pqueue-b66d0294.
Commits 312c317b (initial) + d0b0c02f (real numeric flusher sweep after codex flagged the two-regime version as an overclaim).

WHAT WAS DELIVERED:
- REAL numeric E3 commit-latency-bound sweep [1,5,20,100] ms (TP-002:198), each realized as a group-commit objectlog
  SegmentConfig::new(1 MiB, bound_ms) with an EXTERNALIZED flusher (spawn_latency_flusher driving flush_tick — the same
  mechanism composed_group_commit / the E3 live perf test use). LIVENESS PROOF: a co-buffering push does NOT ack without
  the flusher (now_or_never observes it still Pending); per-bound segments_sealed advances — so the numeric bound is the
  genuine seal trigger, not inert config behind a size seal (this closes codex's prior overclaim).
- AC-TXN-1/2/3 (the row-204 transaction invariants attached to the sweep) proven BYTE-IDENTICAL across all 4 bounds:
  final observable state pending=3/leased=0/complete=0/failed=0/eligible=3/active_leases=0 identical at every bound;
  only latency/cost metadata differs. Unknown-outcome replay proven across kill/reopen at EACH bound.
- Categorical two-regime invariance (force-seal vs group-commit) retained: AC-TXN-1/2/3 identical proven-invariant sets +
  AC-TXN-6 parity (final QueueMetrics incl complete/failed, eligibility order, active-lease set, terminal outcomes,
  request_id idempotency) — codex confirmed these have real teeth (byte-identical vector equality, non-trivial).
- AC-TXN-4: capability-N/A for a REAL structural reason (crash-point matrix runs directly on ObjectLog, bypassing the
  composed commit-latency write path — bound-independent), not harness convenience.

HONEST RESIDUAL (row is PARTIAL → split): AC-TXN-5 (hybrid-strict) + AC-TXN-5A (hybrid-async) were NOT swept across the
numeric object-log latency bounds (they pin SegmentConfig::new(1,1) today). Their invariants are governed primarily by the
HybridProjectionStore apply barrier / async debt — a knob orthogonal to the object-log commit-latency bound — so a numeric
object-log-latency sweep of them is EXPECTED to be invariant but is UNPROVEN. Recorded as an explicit GAP (not a faked pass,
not a false capability-N/A) → tracked in pqueue-b66d0294.

Codex adversarial review (both rounds): invariant-equality assertions SOUND with real teeth; the initial two-regime-only
"pass" was an overclaim (only compared force-seal vs group-commit, not the numeric sweep) → reworked into the genuine
numeric flusher sweep and honestly downgraded to partial for the AC-TXN-5/5A residual.
Verify (independent re-run, 0 failed): cargo test -p pqueue-conformance ac_txn_7 → 1 passed; cargo test -p pqueue-conformance
→ all binaries 0 failed (84 passed, 2 ignored).

Closing this bead for the delivered numeric sweep of the row-204 transaction triad + AC-TXN-4 N/A; the AC-TXN-5/5A numeric
sweep is tracked in pqueue-b66d0294.
summary: real numeric E3 latency sweep [1/5/20/100ms] proves AC-TXN-1/2/3 byte-identical (flusher liveness-proven); AC-TXN-5/5A sweep split to pqueue-b66d0294 (row partial)
